[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Isobel was born in 1732. She passed away in 1821. <ref>Irvine Old Parish Churchyard her gravestone says she died on 5 June 1821, aged 89 </ref>

On 19 September 1769, Roup of houses, yards, etc. belonging to Isobel and Mary Glasgow<ref>https://ayrshirearchives.files.wordpress.com/2019/04/irvine-burgh-catalogue-2017-watermarked.pdf</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1077]] is assessed at 79% (probable). Isobel’s 1732 birth and Irvine burial history fit John Glasgow and Agnes Ferguson’s family sequence, which independently includes James in 1718, John in 1721 and Robert in 1728. The same full couple is stated in her family account.

Probable extension of the documented Irvine household; the grave account does not itself name her father.

Next useful test: Find Isobel’s baptism or an estate entry in the John/Agnes family.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-1127 WikiTree profile export for Glasgow-1127]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.

=== Verified 1766 uncle entry ===
The printed service-of-heirs index names Isobel Rankine (or Glasgow), wife of [[Rankin-5155|John Rankine]], wright in Irvine, as heir-portioner-general to her uncle James Glasgow, shipmaster there. The entry is dated and recorded 9 May 1766, monthly number 21. The index supplies no parent for Isobel or James and names no particular property. Its description must not be converted into a claim about moveable property. The underlying service is uninspected. The uncle is not yet identified with [[Glasgow-4158|James of the Rae household]], [[Glasgow-1140|the Castle minister]] or the 1740 master of the Prosperity of Irvine.<ref>[https://www.familysearch.org/library/books/viewer/874324/?offset=0#page=97&viewer=picture&o=info&n=0&q= Scotland Chancery Office, Decennial Indexes to the Services of Heirs, vol. II, index 1760–1769, p. 15, Isobel Rankine (or Glasgow), registration 9 May 1766, monthly 21; FamilySearch book 874324, image 97]. Printed page visually inspected 11 November 2026; underlying service uninspected.</ref>
